page_title: CAG 0-3 INT | Cagliari v Inter 28/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Wonderful pass from Mehdi Taremi (Inter) for Lautaro Martinez, but they can't profit from it as Simone Scuffet comes off his line to collect.
90+1' Inter are ruled offside.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Doveri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
85' What an amazing save by Yann Sommer! Mattia Felici (Cagliari) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
84' Roberto Piccoli goes off the pitch and Mattia Felici (Cagliari) comes on.
81' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
80' It's time for a substitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes on in place of Hakan Calhanoglu.
80' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Kristjan Asllani (Inter) replaces Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mehdi Taremi (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Marcus Thuram.
78' 0 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Simone Scuffet no chance!
78' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
78' The players claim that Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. The referee gives a penalty kick to Inter!!
77' There's an opportunity for Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

77' What a great touch by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
75' Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
74' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
73' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a chip pass into the box, but Simone Scuffet is quickest to intercept the ball.
73' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Federico Dimarco will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
73' The attendance for today's match is 16412.
73' Substitution. Nicolo Barella will be replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
71' Substitution. Antoine Makoumbou makes his way off the pitch and Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) comes on as his replacement.
71' 0 - 2 Goal! Nicolo Barella puts a cross into the box and finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the right post. He makes it 0:2.
70' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
70' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
69' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) offside.
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:15. 0:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
64' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Roberto Piccoli, but Yann Sommer displays great awareness to stop him.
61' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
61' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) prepares to take a corner kick.

60' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Simone Scuffet. This effort really didn't trouble him.
59' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Gianluca Gaetano and he is replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
59' Adam Obert will be replaced by Razvan Marin (Cagliari).
59' Yann Bisseck (Inter) commits a foul and Daniele Doveri immediately signals a free kick.
57' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) plays a long ball to Roberto Piccoli, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
56' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Henrikh Mkhitaryan. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.

53' 0 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Nicolo Barella showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) manages to convert it into a sweet goal. He heads it inside the right post and gets on the scoresheet – 0:1.
53' The free kick is taken by Federico Dimarco (Inter), but ball is cleared.
53' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniele Doveri signals. Inter will take a free kick.
51' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Inter as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
50' There's a break in play and referee Daniele Doveri must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Inter using VAR. This could be interesting!
50' Surely that's handball by one of the Cagliari players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

50' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives the ball from the corner kick well outside the box and fires a projectile goalwards. He fails to get the ball through a wall of players in front of him as it deflects away off one of his own teammates. Yann Bisseck (Inter) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the left post.
50' The corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is hurriedly cleared.
49' Marcus Thuram (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
48' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) sends a long ball in, but Simone Scuffet comfortably gathers the ball.
46' Davide Nicola has made a change at the break. Mateusz Wieteska has come on in place of Yerry Mina (Cagliari).
46' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

45+2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Daniele Doveri signals a set piece. Inter win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
41' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
41' Nicolo Barella (Inter) collects a rebound after the corner kick and produces a long-range blast. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by the keeper.
41' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

40' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.
39' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
39' Adam Obert (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
38' The resulting free kick from Federico Dimarco (Inter) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
37' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) brings an opponent down and Daniele Doveri interrupts the game. Inter get a free kick.
36' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Simone Scuffet intercepts the ball.
34' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
34' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

33' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) attempts to find Roberto Piccoli, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
28' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
28' Marcus Thuram (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
24' The total number of attempts is 2:4. 0:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
20' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but Yann Sommer comes off his line to gather the ball.
18' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
18' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

17' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
16' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
14' Marcus Thuram passes to Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.

13' The cross into the penalty area from Federico Dimarco (Inter) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
13' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) is caught offside yet again.
12' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
10' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
9' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
9' Marcus Thuram (Inter) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Cagliari.
8' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
8' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Cagliari have a corner.
7' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yann Sommer, who smothers the ball.

5' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) whips the ball into the box and Roberto Piccoli takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
4' Hakan Calhanoglu slings over a decent looking cross towards Stefan de Vrij (Inter), who outjumps his marker in the middle of the box but sends a poor header high over the bar.
4' Federico Dimarco (Inter) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

3' A nice pass finds Marcus Thuram (Inter) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the bottom left corner, but Simone Scuffet pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
1' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Cagliari will kick the game off.
Daniele Doveri is the one to supervise the game today.
